note: Rhythm/structure rules JSON Schema cannot express. Ids and severities are machine-checked against schema/semantic_validate.py RULES by verify_all.py.

rules.rule: Exactly one HERO node per page (both templates open with one).
The first node that is not SHELL/UTILITY is the HERO. cosmos-home nodes are in reading order (z-order lives in contract.layer), so the loader, top bar and phone menu may precede it.
Sections with constraints.mustBeLast (chrome.case-footer) are the last node.
onePerPage sections appear at most once.
constraints.requires: the flybar and hover label need the cosmos; box views need the glass box; the toast needs the project view.
constraints.templates restricts a section to its template family.
route matches the template's routePattern (^/$ or ^/work/[a-z0-9-]+$), in both modes.
A reference cosmos-home spec must be bound to a route mapped to cosmos-home in routes.json.
overlay.glass-box content.views equals the set of view sections present (project, selected, about, contact).
On cosmos-home every navigation action (top bar, phone menu) other than 'work' has its view section on the page.
index.next-case href is a /work/<slug> route other than the page's own route.
Only SHELL/UTILITY sections may be retrievalEligible:false; nodes cannot override the contract.
Two adjacent nodes of the same category, except the named exceptions.

exceptions.why: top bar + phone menu are both chrome
case bodies run several boards in a row (placeholderSections: images i>=4)

rules.rule: The same section twice in a row (media.case-image exempt: real runs of boards; editorial.case-text twice in a row is real on /work/omnifield and /work/vantage but still warns).
A case-study body should contain at least one editorial.case-text (every served case has three).
At most 3 nodes using an ambient-loop pattern.
